name: international-patient-summary-app-with-kotlin
description: Google Android app (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3; no Java) that opens and shows HL7 FHIR International Patient Summary documents. Saved on the phone only, encrypted (Android Keystore key), no network; checks documents exactly as the backend service does.
license: MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause OR GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only

Specification.name: Spec §1
Specification.description: Purpose, and the ideas taken from MyIPS

Specification.name: Spec §4
Specification.description: List, summary and About screens (M-LIST, M-VIEW, M-ABOUT, M-TAB, M-PEOPLE)

Specification.name: Spec §5
Specification.description: M-SHARE, M-PDF (the one-page PDF), M-PRIV, M-STORE (the encrypted store)

Core.name: Check
Core.description: M-CHECK-1/2, Refusal codes and pointers (the service's S-API-2)

Core.name: Absent
Core.description: none known, not recorded, unavailable, missing

Core.name: EntryReader
Core.description: one entry as a row with detail lines

Core.name: People
Core.description: M-PEOPLE-1, which summaries are the same person (identifier, or name and birth date; transitive)

Core.name: OnePage
Core.description: M-PDF-1/2, the one-page PDF's blocks, priority, plans and fitting (a page counter passed in); paper, file name, title metadata

App.name: MainActivity
App.description: privacy cover, share sheet, share-file cleanup, a document from another app (M-LOAD-4; onCreate and onNewIntent, launchMode singleTask)

App.name: Incoming
App.description: M-LOAD-4, which part of an ACTION_VIEW or ACTION_SEND intent holds the document; the JSON types the manifest names

App.name: DocumentFiles
App.description: the size-first, capped read of a picked, dropped or sent file (M-CHECK-2)

App.name: AppViewModel
App.description: screen state (kept through a fold, M-TAB-4), people, open, examples, delete, relationship, forget a person, clear; loads and saves the encrypted store on one thread

App.name: SummaryStore
App.description: the summaries and each person's relationship in memory (M-PEOPLE-3); index and restore for the encrypted store

App.name: EncryptedStore
App.description: M-STORE-1..4: AES-256-GCM files in noBackupFilesDir/store/, checked again at launch

App.name: KeystoreKeys
App.description: the store's non-exportable AES-256 key in the Android Keystore

App.name: ShareFiles
App.description: FileProvider share file, the JSON or the PDF (M-SHARE-1, M-PDF-3)

App.name: OnePagePdf
App.description: M-PDF-1/2, the PDF in the reader's words, laid out with StaticLayout and drawn with PdfDocument

App.name: SummaryScreen
App.description: alert, patient, document, sections; the Share menu (file or PDF)

App.name: Manifest
App.description: no network permission, no backup or device transfer, FileProvider, Open with and Share filters for application/json and application/fhir+json only

App.name: Tests
App.description: JVM unit tests; fixtures in app/src/test/resources/fixtures/

App.name: SmokeTest
App.description: Compose UI Test on an emulator: load examples, open one, share as PDF, Clear all

App.name: OnePagePdfTest
App.description: the PDF of every example (en-US, en-GB, ar) and two crafted summaries on an emulator; pdfOut=1 writes them to cacheDir/share/
